is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado who does not hold a license to practice medicine issued by the Colorado medical board pursuant to article 240 of this title 12 or a license to practice podiatry issued by the Colorado podiatry board as provided by this article 290.

title_protection.quote: A person shall not advertise in any form or hold himself or herself out to the public as a podiatrist, or, in any sign or any advertisement, use the word "podiatrist", "foot specialist", "foot correctionist", "foot expert", "practipedist", "podologist", or any other terms or letters indicating or implying that the person is a podiatrist or that the person practices or holds himself or herself out as practicing podiatry or foot correction in any manner, without having, at the time of so doing, a valid, unsuspended, and unrevoked license as required by this article 290.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or offers or attempts to practice podiatry within this state without an active license issued under this article 290 is subject to penalties pursuant to section 12-20-407 (1)(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or material deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license or in taking required examinations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or material deception, or making a misleading omission, in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license to practice podiatry in this state or any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of the podiatry practice act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this article 290.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of podiatry by an unlicensed person or by a person whose license is suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting in the practice of podiatry any person not licensed to practice podiatry or any person whose license to practice podiatry is suspended;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of the practice of podiatry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatry as a partner, agent, or employee of an unlicensed person or unauthorized corporation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as otherwise provided in section 25-3-103.7, practicing podiatry as: The partner, agent, or employee of, or in joint venture with, any person who does not hold a license to practice podiatry within this state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of the podiatry act, applicable rules, or final agency orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this article 290, an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12, any rule promulgated by the board pursuant to this article 290, or any final agency order;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing habit-forming drugs or controlled substances outside the scope of legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), other than in the course of legitimate professional practice, which includes only prescriptions related to the scope of podiatric medicine;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating possession, distribution, or use of controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution, or use of any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness, condition, or behavioral/mental health disorder affecting ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to: Notify the board of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral or mental health disorder that affects the podiatrist's ability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is misleading, deceptive, or false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is misleading, deceptive, or false;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or abuse of health insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation or abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during care or within six months following termination of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or during the six-month period immediately following the termination of such care.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any procedure beyond the podiatrist's training and competence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure in the course of patient care beyond the podiatrist's training and competence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and repeated ordering or performance of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests, treatment, or services without clinical justification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any of the following activities and practices: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies; the administration, without clinical justification, of treatment that is demonstrably unnecessary;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries or failing to make essential entries on patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries or repeatedly failing to make essential entries on patient records;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to complete or falsifying the renewal questionnaire
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to complete and submit the renewal questionnaire, or failing to report all of the relevant facts, or falsifying any information on the questionnaire as required pursuant to section 12-290-119;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board any podiatrist known or believed to have violated the unprofessional conduct provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any podiatrist known to have violated or, upon information or belief, believed to have violated any of the provisions of this subsection (3);

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees or billing for services performed by an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees or compensation or billing for services performed by an unlicensed person as prohibited by section 12-290-122;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report adverse actions taken by other licensing agencies, peer review bodies, or courts within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board within thirty days any adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing agency in another state, territory, or country or any peer review body, health-care institution, professional or medical society or association, governmental agency, law enforcement agency, or court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report surrender of a license or authorization while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or the surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating workers' compensation provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the provisions of section 8-42-101 (3.6);

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions governing unlicensed persons operating ionizing radiation equipment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the provisions of section 12-290-202 or any rule of the board adopted pursuant to that section;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a board complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint issued pursuant to section 12-290-113.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territory, or country for acts substantially constituting unprofessional conduct under Colorado law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The discipline of a licensee for acts related to the practice of podiatry in another state, territory, or country shall be deemed unprofessional conduct.

insurance_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado unless the person purchases and maintains professional liability insurance as follows: If the person performs surgical procedures, professional liability insurance shall be maintained in an amount not less than one million dollars per claim and three million dollars per year for all claims.

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: A podiatrist may only treat a soft tissue wound below the mid-calf if the patient is being treated by a physician for his or her underlying medical condition or if the podiatrist refers the patient to a physician for further treatment of the underlying medical condition.

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A physician assistant licensed pursuant to article 240 of this title 12 may perform acts that constitute the practice of podiatry to the extent and in the manner authorized by rules promulgated by the board.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Be construed to prohibit the recommending, advertising, fitting, adjusting, or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports, or similar mechanical appliances and foot remedies by retail dealers and manufacturers;
